title: Re-Initializable `CErc20.initialize` — State Reset / Privilege Escalation
impact: `CErc20.initialize(...)` is `public` and has **no `initialized` guard**. Anyone can call it again on a live delegator (via `delegateToImplementation` or the fallback) to overwrite `comptroller`, `interestRateModel`, `initialExchangeRateMantissa`, `name`, `symbol`, `decimals`, and `underlying`. An attacker can point the market at a malicious comptroller (allowing uncollateralized borrows) or a malicious interest rate model (setting `borrowRateMaxMantissa`-exceeding rates via a hostile model), draining all supplied funds. `CToken.initialize` (inherited) is likewise re-callable.
